title: Shop calendar (opening days, closures, local events)
summary: Daily operational calendar for the Valdena Gelato Shop with one row per calendar_date, an is_open flag and a free-text event_name for local events. Catalog states coverage from 2022-01-01, still updating, refreshed weekly (last refreshed 2026-10-10). Not profiled: no sample was read because access is via warehouse SQL and no probe tool was available for it. Covers the shop only, not national holidays or weather.

fields.name: event_name
fields.description: Local event that day, if any

schema.notes: Column descriptions are one-line only; no data types beyond those listed, no population rules for is_open documented.

spatial.code_system: free text event names; calendar_date ISO date (implied)
spatial.notes: Single shop location in northern Italy per use-case spec; no location column in the catalog entry.

documentation_excerpts: Opening days, closures and local events for the shop. (catalog description)

quality_notes: No wiki page documents this table; wiki_backlinks is empty (get_catalog_entry internal.store.calendar). The search returned only the catalog entry and the unrelated till-migration page (till_migration_2024, last edited 2024-03-12), which does not mention the calendar.

Row count: catalog row_count_approx = 1500, but 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-10 spans about 1,744 calendar days (arithmetic from catalog dates). Either coverage is incomplete or the table is not one row per day; not verified because no sample was read.
is_open population method (till log vs manual roster) is undocumented.
event_name is free text with no stated coverage or controlled vocabulary.
Refresh is weekly, so the most recent days may be stale relative to the 2026-10-15 as_of date; last refresh 2026-10-10.
Catalog says coverage starts 2022, which covers the history window (2023-06-01 onward) but this is not confirmed by a sample.

Relation to the 2024-02-05 to 2024-03-10 till outage (till_migration_2024) is undocumented: during that period the calendar may show is_open = true with no sales rows, which would look like zero sales if not handled.
